witnesses.role: fifth argument is the route gain-pair array
fourth argument is the collected row array
third argument is the collected row count
sixth argument is the low byte of the caller mode input
callee reads the sixth stack byte
callee returns its caller-supplied result-storage pointer
first output descriptor comes from the bus input array when present
publish that address into each original route row
multiply incoming previous gain in float32
write effective previous gain back into the gain-pair array
multiply incoming target gain in float32
write effective target gain back into the gain-pair array
direct submission uses the sink descriptor
direct submission calls the owned sink submit body
frame end clears only the input-present bit

evidenceBoundary.exact: Borrowed selected body windows authenticate the six integer/pointer bus-mix arguments and caller result-storage return, existing bus input/reset storage and native context descriptor publication.
evidenceBoundary.direct: Paired sampled bus mix retains actual input rows and completed bus descriptor/prefix. All source sample/release, route publication and bus reset invocations are retained while the recorder is active; each field is a bounded non-atomic read. Current numeric extension reads the incoming gain pair, first previous/target matrix pointer/words and guarded stereo right-plane words beside the original first-plane prefix. Return storage is anonymous word0/word8 data, not a proved task/dependency identity.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: First rows only. Reset and source-write intervals exclude observed intervening reuse only when the loss-free stream and zero intentional skips for those endpoints hold; other writers, lifetimes and asynchronous dispatch remain conditions.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Complete allocation generations, all route rows, bus/effect hierarchy, full matrix/filter history, unrecorded planar samples and complete buffers, final Event contribution to device output and audibility.
evidenceBoundary.structuralOnly: First matrix words and filter target are bounded stored values; complete matrix layout, filter history and effective processing are separate. Anonymous result-storage initialization/move does not establish asynchronous work.

resultStorageLeaves.readOrder: Initialize word0 to zero and word8 to the all-one sentinel; return the supplied storage.
Move word0 and word8 into supplied destination storage, clear the source and return the destination. No scheduling or waiting is performed.

stereoPrefixSelection.scope: First four second-plane float32 words only when all three recorded layout/frame guards hold. No other stereo layout or whole second plane is inferred.

sinkHandoffBoundary.direct: Sink conversion stores the converted descriptor and sets input-present. Non-resampling frame-end uses that same inline descriptor for native submission and clears input-present.
sinkHandoffBoundary.conditional: A write/consume join additionally requires every sink-input and frame-end endpoint in a loss-free scope, matching current descriptor fields, direct non-ring/non-resampled selection, original submit nesting and successful returns.
sinkHandoffBoundary.unresolved: Accepted handoff windows establish conditional saved prefixes only. Complete buffers, resampled/ring/silent branches, bus-output generations, individual Event contribution and audibility remain open.

consumerBodies.readOrder: Cohort source indices select the filter and descriptor arrays; save the last two source samples into filter history, expand each planar input channel into a gain/matrix row, then dispatch accumulation without a filter recurrence.
Multiply previous and target matrix coefficients by the respective gains, classify nonzero constant or ramp coefficients, then multiply source samples and add into existing planar output.

evidenceBoundary.direct: Selected native bodies establish the unfiltered consumer input boundary, eight argument forwarding, padded matrix rows and accumulation into existing output.
evidenceBoundary.conditional: The bounded first-output equation requires one first-row source, constant gain/matrix, one nonzero channel contribution, zero initial output and observed nearest MXCSR rounding; unsupported branches are withheld.
evidenceBoundary.unresolved: Native consumer observations are prepared but not captured. Filters, ramps, unsupported layouts, complete bus generations and Event-to-device attribution remain open.

consumerHook.name: AkSoundEngine.unfilteredMatrixConsumer
consumerHook.evidenceBoundary: Sampled same-call original unfiltered consumer entry/return only. Single first-row cohort, full bounded frames and explicit layouts permit four first-output samples; source release/allocation lifetime, filters, ramps, other contributions and Event-to-device attribution remain separate.
